units.title: Устойчивые сравнения: as busy as a bee
units.theoryHtml:
Популярные сравнения as ... as — выучи как готовые фразы:

ФразаСмысл
as busy as a beeкак пчёлка — очень занят
as cool as a cucumberспокоен как удав
as easy as pie / ABCпроще простого
as fit as a fiddleв отличной форме
as light as a featherлегкий как пёрышко
as quiet as a mouseтише воды
as stubborn as a muleупрямый как осёл
as clear as mudясно как день — иронично «ничего не ясно»

Отрицание часто неожиданно: as easy as pie → not as easy as it looks.

⚠ Частые ошибки: выдумывать свои сравнения дословно с русского: as a fish in water — англичане так не говорят; есть take to it like a duck to water.

Мини-диалог:
— How's the new job? — I'm as busy as a bee, but the boss is as cool as a cucumber.
— Is the training hard? — As easy as pie for someone like me!

options: She's as busy as a bee.
She's so busy as a bee.
She's as busy like a bee.

exercises.prompt: After the gym I felt ___ ___ ___ (как новенький). (as good as new → 4 слова)
He took to coding like a duck ___ ___ (к воде). (2 слова)

units.title: Цепочки принадлежности и a couple of
units.shortDescription: My sister's friend's car + a couple of, dozens of.
units.theoryHtml:
Цепочки 's допустимы, но длинные лучше перестроить: my sister's friend's car (машина друга моей сестры) — корректно, но громоздко: лучше the car belonging to my sister's friend.

Примерное количество:

ВыражениеСмыслПример
a couple ofпара (2) / несколькоa couple of days, a couple of friends
a few / severalнесколькоseveral times
dozens ofдюжины (много)dozens of emails
loads of / tons ofкуча (разг.)loads of fun, tons of work
plenty ofмного (достаточно)plenty of time

После dozens of / loads of / plenty of — мн.ч. или неисчисляемое: plenty of time (не times!).

⚠ Частые ошибки: a couple of friends is → are (в брит. разговорном). loads of funs → loads of fun. a couple minutes → a couple of minutes.

Мини-диалог:
— How long will the repair take? — A couple of hours. But there are dozens of cars ahead of you.
— Ugh. OK, I'll grab a coffee. I have plenty of time and tons of patience.

exercises.prompt: Take your time — there's ___ of it.
There were ___ people at the concert.
Whose phone is it? — It's my ___ (жены брата).

units.title: Разделительные вопросы — ревизия
units.shortDescription: You're coming, aren't you? — хвосты и ответы-ловушки.
units.theoryHtml:
Разделительный вопрос = утверждение + хвост-вопрос. Правило: утверждение → отрицательный хвост; отрицание → утвердительный. Глагол хвоста = вспомогательный глагол предложения.

ПредложениеХвост
You're coming,aren't you?
She doesn't like it,does she?
They went home,didn't they?
He can swim,can't he?
I'm late,aren't I? (особая форма!)
Let's go,shall we?
Open the window,will you?

Ответы-ловушки: «Yes» на отрицательный вопрос подтверждает отрицание: You don't like it, do you? — No, I don't / Yes, I do (мне нравится).

⚠ Частые ошибки: I'm late, amn't I? → aren't I. He has a car, hasn't he? — верно в британском; в американском: doesn't he. Наречия never/seldom делают предложение отрицательным: He never smiles, does he?

Мини-диалог:
— It's a beautiful day, isn't it? — Yes, it is! You don't have work today, do you?
— No, I don't. Let's go to the beach, shall we?

exercises.explanation: never — отрицание по смыслу → does he.

exercises.prompt: «You don't like fish, do you?» Ответ «мне нравится»:

units.title: Пассив — ревизия всех форм
units.shortDescription: Все формы пассива в одной таблице + типичные ошибки.
units.theoryHtml:
Пассив — be в нужном времени + V3:

ВремяПассивПример
Present Simpleam/is/are + V3English is spoken here.
Past Simplewas/were + V3It was stolen.
Present Continuousam/is/are being + V3It is being cleaned.
Past Continuouswas/were being + V3It was being cleaned.
Present Perfecthas/have been + V3It has been done.
Past Perfecthad been + V3It had been done.
Futurewill be + V3It will be done.
модальныеmust/can/should be + V3It must be done.

Кем? — by: written by Orwell. Чем? — with: cut with a knife.

Когда пассив уместен: исполнитель неизвестен/неважен: My bike was stolen! (кем — неважно). Наука и новости: The vaccine was developed in 2021.

⚠ Частые ошибки: is be done, will been done, was be done — запомни схему. Глаголы без пассива: have (владеть), fit, suit, lack, resemble.

Мини-диалог:
— Was the package delivered? — It says it was delivered yesterday, but nothing has been left at the door.
— Maybe it will be delivered today. It should have been sent by courier.

exercises.prompt: The thief was caught ___ a security guard.
The door was opened ___ a key.
Nothing ___ ___ ___ (было сказано) about it. (had been said)

units.title: Союзы — финальная ревизия
units.shortDescription: however, therefore, moreover, in case — связки продвинутого уровня.
units.theoryHtml:
Формальные связки для письменной речи:

СвязкаСмыслПример
howeverоднакоHe was tired. However, he continued.
thereforeследовательноIt was late; therefore, we left.
moreover / furthermoreболее тогоMoreover, the price is fair.
in caseна случай еслиTake an umbrella in case it rains.
even soи всё жеEven so, it's worth trying.
on the other handс другой стороныOn the other hand, it's risky.
as a resultв результатеAs a result, sales doubled.

however — не союз, а наречие: после него точка или точка с запятой, перед ним тоже: It was late. However, we left. / It was late; however, we left. (не It was late, however we left — запятая недостаточна).

in case vs if: Take an umbrella in case it rains (запас на будущее) vs We'll cancel if it rains (условие). После in case — тоже Present о будущем: in case it rains.

⚠ Частые ошибки: in case of it rains → in case it rains (in case of + существительное: in case of rain). ,however, запятые с двух сторон — в начале предложения лучше.

Мини-диалог:
— Should we take the ferry? — The weather is bad. However, ferries rarely stop. Take a jacket in case it gets windy.
— In case of an emergency? — Life vests are under the seats, therefore — relax and enjoy.

exercises.prompt: He was exhausted. ___, he finished the race.
It was raining; ___, we stayed in.
Take a jumper ___ it gets cold.
The flat is small. ___, it's cheap and central.

options: Take cash in case of you need it.
Take cash in case you need it.
Take cash in case of needing cash you need.
Take cash however you need it.

exercises.prompt: ___ of rain, the event moves indoors.
The first attempt failed; ___, the second succeeded.
Sales doubled. ___, the company hired ten people.
Bring a map ___ ___ (на случай) you get lost. (2 слова)

units.title: Итоговая ревизия времён — диагностика
units.shortDescription: Все 12 времён на одной странице — шпаргалка и тест.
units.theoryHtml:
ВремяФормаМаркерПример
Present Simpledo/doesusually, every dayI work here.
Present Continuousam/is/are + -ingnow, at the momentI'm working now.
Past SimpleV2yesterday, agoI worked there.
Past Continuouswas/were + -ingwhile, at 5 pm yesterdayI was working at 6.
Present Perfecthave/has + V3just, ever, sinceI've worked here for years.
Present Perfect Continuoushave/has been + -ingfor 2 hours, since morningI've been working since 8.
Past Perfecthad + V3before, by thenI had worked there before.
Past Perfect Continuoushad been + -ingfor 2 hours beforeI had been working for hours.
Future Simplewill + V1tomorrow, soonI'll work tomorrow.
Future Continuouswill be + -ingat 6 pm tomorrowI'll be working at 6.
Future Perfectwill have + V3by next yearI'll have finished by June.
going toam/is/are going toпланI'm going to work abroad.

Алгоритм выбора: 1) Есть ли маркер времени? 2) Действие завершено или идёт? 3) Важен процесс или результат? 4) Связь с настоящим?

⚠ Главные ошибки: will после when/if; have seen + yesterday; was + V3 без being; am knowing; since + период.

Мини-диалог (все времена!):
— I 've been working here since 2020. Before that, I had been living in Japan for five years.
— Wow. And what will you be doing next year? — By then I 'll have finished my project and 'll move closer to the sea. When I move, I'll send you photos!

exercises.explanation: since + до сих пор — Present Perfect.

exercises.prompt: When I arrived, they ___ for an hour.
I'll call you when I ___ the results.
Look at the sky! It ___ all day — the ground is soaked.
This time tomorrow, we ___ on the beach.
By the time you read this, I ___ ___ (уйду). (leave → Future Perfect)
She ___ (живёт) in Paris since she graduated. (live)
